description: Command names that tools/Test-SymbolReference.ps1 accepts without finding them in the tree or in the running PowerShell. commands: cmdlets of modules a Linux host lacks, by module. hooks: commands the code calls only when a module provides them. illustrative: names an example invents, each with where and why.

illustrative.Invoke-WhateverOcr: docs/ocr.md: the placeholder engine an OCR provider example calls
illustrative.Send-KeyYourNewHost: docs/host-io.md: the placeholder key sender of a new host type
illustrative.Send-Scroll: docs/host-io.md: an example name for a new input verb
illustrative.Send-Drag: docs/host-io.md: an example name for a new input verb
illustrative.Start-GuestRepair: docs/framework-implementation-notes.md: an example name for a new sibling dispatcher
illustrative.Confirm-X: automation/Yuruna.Result.psm1: a placeholder for any Confirm- predicate in an example
illustrative.Start-Log: test/modules/README.md: a hypothetical name the text explains must not be added
illustrative.Test-VM: docs/design/naming.md and host/README.md: the heading 'Test-VM names' names test VMs, not a command

hooks.Get-HostElevationCommand: test/modules/Test.RunnerElevation.psm1 prefers it when a host driver exports one
